hypothesis: On small bounded coding tasks, removing the broad self-review checklist may reduce unnecessary work without reducing behavioral correctness or preservation of unrelated edits.
scope: Small bounded coding tasks only. Do not generalize to production, security-sensitive, or broad interface changes.
comparison: Reuse matched baseline and candidate suites with identical tasks, graders, prompts, model, harness, settings, and repeat count. Change only skills_root to the prepared candidate. Use the existing comparison report.
decision: This is a falsifiable development hypothesis, not a claim of improvement. Inspect failures, then confirm promising changes on fresh held-out tasks before changing the shipped skill.
